title: Hats and swing
goal: Add offbeat open hats and closed 8th hats, then give them a little swing.
explain: stack(...) plays several patterns at once, so the kick and hats live in one part. [~ oh]*4 means "a rest, then an open hat" repeated four times, which lands the open hat between the kicks. A gain pattern like "[0.25 0.45]*4" alternates quiet and loud hats, which already sounds less robotic. swingBy(1/6, 4) delays every second subdivision in each quarter of the bar by a sixth, the classic shuffle.
try_prompt: Add closed 8th hats with alternating accents and offbeat open hats to drums.js, with a light swing.
